daily_quests.title: ASX 200 Price Momentum Ranking
daily_quests.description: Using ASX 200 historical price data, write a SQL query with window functions to calculate the 30-day price momentum for each stock. Rank stocks by momentum within each sector. Use ROW_NUMBER() to identify the top 3 performers per sector, and LAG() to compare current price against 30 days prior. Return columns: date, ticker, sector, current_price, price_30_days_ago, momentum_percentage, sector_rank. Filter for the most recent trading date only.

daily_quests.title: NSW Road Crash Data Cleaning & Feature Engineering
daily_quests.description: Download NSW Road Crash Data (2020–2025). Clean the dataset by: (1) handling missing values in crash_type and severity columns (document your strategy), (2) standardising location data (removing extra whitespace, converting to title case), (3) creating new features: hour_of_day (from crash_time), is_fatal (binary from severity), and region (grouping LGA into broader NSW regions). Export the cleaned dataset as 'nsw_crashes_cleaned.csv' with 8–10 rows of sample output printed to console showing your transformations.

daily_quests.title: Australian Wine Production & Export Analysis Pipeline
daily_quests.description: Build a Python + SQL pipeline: (1) In Python, fetch or load Australian wine production statistics (by region and vintage year). Clean the data, handle any missing production volumes, and load it into a SQLite database table called 'wine_production'. (2) In SQL, write a query using CTEs to calculate: total production by region, year-over-year growth rate (using LAG()), and the top 3 regions by average export volume. (3) Export results to 'wine_analysis_report.csv' with columns: region, year, production_volume, yoy_growth_pct, export_volume. Document your data cleaning decisions in comments within the Python script.
daily_quests.dataset: Australian Wine Production Statistics — Wine Australia (wineaustralia.com) or ABS agriculture data
